base_config: agent-configurations/vapi-agent-config.json (transcriber Soniox stt-rt-v5, voice Vapi Clara v2, GPT-4.1 at temperature 0, 1,000 max tokens, its speaking plans)

model.messages: [system: redteam/tau2_airline/system-prompt.txt, then reference_bot_settings.SHARED_RULES, then reference_bot_settings.OPENING_RULE with the greeting from redteam/tau2_airline/first-message.txt] + the kept turns
model.tools: the 14 airline tools (redteam/tau2_airline/tool-definitions.json), as function definitions, each with server.url = TOOL_URL/vapi/<token>, async false

overrides.transcriber: the base transcriber plus the airline's transcription hints (voice_clients.AIRLINE_HINTS)

connection: POST https://api.vapi.ai/call with transport vapi.websocket, pcm_s16le raw at 24000 Hz; tools are called back at TOOL_URL
history: the kept turns as the assistant's starting messages, each earlier tool result as a system note naming its call ('Backend result of name(args): result'), since starting messages carry no tool turns; until 26 Nov 2026 earlier tool rounds were left out
turn: Vapi's own turn detection: the caller's line at speaking pace in 20 ms frames, then 100 ms silence frames; the reply is over after 3 s quiet (5 s after a tool result)
reply: Vapi's transcript of the assistant's speech
line_cap: 13 calls at once (the account refuses past about 16)
greeting: Hi! How can I help you today? (redteam/tau2_airline/first-message.txt)
caller_audio: the caller's newest line as audio: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts, voice 'alloy', PCM16 at 24000 Hz; earlier kept turns go in as history, never as audio
session_per_caller_turn: a new session each caller turn; a tool call and its result stay in that turn's session
